motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduce animation and transition duration when requested.

components.name: Category tab
components.description: Section anchor within the four-category settings index.
components.css: .settings-tab { min-height:36px; padding:6px 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; font:500 12px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif; background:#fff; color:#2364d8; }

components.name: Navigation choice
components.css: .navigation-toggle { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; min-height:43px; padding:10px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#e8f5fd; color:#2364d8; font:500 12px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Clean editorial settings with neutral surfaces and one blue accent. Categories separate feed, navigation, appearance, and additional tools.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed header with original attribution and updated-fork link

rules.name: Preserve setting behavior
rules.body: Keep storage keys and automatic saving intact; keep all sections mounted.

dos: Use semantic colors and keyboard-accessible controls.
donts: Do not introduce a save button or decorative imagery.
